summary: This bill requires the Postal Service to issue regulations within 90 days mandating that employees and contractors report within three days any traffic crash involving a mail-carrying vehicle that causes injury or death, maintain an internal database of such incidents, and publish annual public reports with aggregated statistics while imposing penalties on noncompliant contractors.
